tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind cards and report pages. Light: neutral off-white (Sne), never pure white.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, report pages, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: Nested areas: table header rows, list items inside a card, hovered rows.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and card borders. Decorative only; not for control outlines.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines of inputs and secondary buttons (3:1 against surface in both themes).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text, headings and icons on bg, surface and surface-subtle.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, captions, hints. 4.5:1 on bg and surface.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links, focus rings, selected and active states (Fjord blue). Not used for buttons.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Amber accent: the rune, highlights and the single sign-off action per view. Fills only; never body text on light.

tokens.name: on-accent
